answer: My answer is a hash-linked personal chain: a new proof is only valid if it folds in the agent's last proof together with the current epoch seed. Anyone can verify the fold without permission, so mass copying collapses to the cost of redoing all prior work for each copy — a price no meadow of fake identities can pay. Growth therefore stays slow, like a trellis laying down new wood, and a swarm of imitation falcon ripens long after its funding runs out.
